records.summary: Independent probe 2026-11-20 (~17:41-17:59 UTC, sandbox, no funds moved, /settle never called). (1) RPC verified from this environment: eth_chainId 0xabe5 (=44005), web3_clientVersion cdk-erigon/2.0-qday-v2.61.19-validium, block height ~3.68M, gasPrice exactly 1 gwei; UA filter: python-urllib default UA gets HTTP 403, curl UA passes (integration gotcha). (2) tUSD8 on-chain: name/symbol tUSD8, decimals 6, EIP-3009 FiatTokenV2-style. (3) Local bare x402-v2 server+client (stdlib http.server + eth-account 0.14.0): 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge (v2 wire: accepts[].amount, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra{name:tUSD8,version:2}) -> client signs Authorization EIP-712 -> server recovers signer and enforces to==payTo, value==price, validity window, nonce freshness -> 200 PAYMENT-RESPONSE (server verify 5.7 ms). Negative probes rejected: 100x overcharge (value_matches_price=false) — server-side price binding blocks the overcharge vector of registry #0000; wrong recipient (to_is_payTo=false). (4) QDay facilitator POST /verify with spec body {x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements} returning HTTP 200 {"isValid":false,"invalidReason":"merchant_not_alive"} on attempt 2 (attempt 1, flat payload, gave 400 invalid_format) — wire format ACCEPTED, next gate is merchant liveness/registration, signature checks not the blocker. (5) Funding blocked: gas faucet gated by Cloudflare Turnstile, tUSD8 claim gated by email+code (HTTP 401 on unauthenticated status probe), Discord faucet needs a Discord account — on-chain settle NOT executed; burner key stays unfunded. (6) PQC: ECDSA only in testnet; PQ precompiles are address(0) stubs, ML-DSA-65 hybrid declared 'in progress' (Phase 2) per qday wiki; off-chain qday-pqc-sdk (Go, liboqs) exists. Verdict: our stack is wire-compatible with QDay x402 v2 up to funding + merchant registration; demo for DoraHacks needs manual faucet step.

records.summary: Independent probe 2026-11-20 (~17:37-17:59 UTC). Two live HTTP calls total, within the pre-set 1-2 free-call budget; no paid call. (1) Demo endpoint with docs ASIN B09DJLW458 -> HTTP 200 from a shared sample copy: free_calls_remaining stayed 3, free_call_used=false, x-price-next-call $0.003, 38757 bytes, request_id 65347b57-f378-4af9-be43-ed5b109c6848 — the canonical docs ASIN never touches the payment path. (2) Live call with own ASIN B08N5WRWNW -> HTTP 404 'ASIN not found on this marketplace domain', 1.73 s, 174 bytes, request_id b675d905-2c2d-47ff-ae71-739204a3a4ba, X-Free-Probes-Remaining 3->2: a miss is 'billed' for keyless clients exactly as llms-full.txt states. (3) Documented payment path (llms.txt / llms-full.txt / .well-known/x402 / dash.apiguru.app/openapi.json): 3 free calls per client per 24h, then 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 accepts, scheme exact), client signs EIP-3009 authorization and retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; gateway settles on-chain only after a billable answer; X-Payment-Status: not-settled and no charge when the failure is theirs; no gas needed (facilitator submits the transfer); one call costs at most $0.05; gateway answers 504 deadline_exceeded itself after 55 s (not billed). Facilitator identity NOT named anywhere (0 matches in openapi.json). (4) Price discrepancy: README says 'about a cent a call', actual documented/live price $0.003 per /v2/product-details call. (5) Paid call NOT executed: sandbox has no funded Base wallet (needs ~$0.003 USDC; gas not needed) — settle timing and PAYMENT-RESPONSE tx hash therefore not observed; the live 402 challenge body (real accepts with per-network assets) also not observed since free probes were not exhausted on purpose. Verdict: suitable as a demo target only AFTER one funded call by the operator; key path and spend controls are ready.

records.summary: Independent probe 2026-11-21 (~03:44-04:05 UTC). Zero settled paid calls (sandbox burner unfunded: Base mainnet native 0, USDC 0), budget regulation <=$0.01 kept at $0.00. Findings. (1) Transport passport: initialize -> protocolVersion 2025-06-18 accepted, stateless (no Mcp-Session-Id header); tools/list free on lite (search_tools + call_tool) and full endpoint (1020 tools in one 1.79MB page, no cursor); full catalog snapshot + docs-all snapshot in evidence. (2) Challenge semantics: calling a paid tool without payment returns MCP result isError=true whose text is the x402 v2 PaymentRequired JSON (x402Version 2, error 'Payment required', resource.url = the MCP endpoint itself, extensions.bazaar with toolName/inputSchema discovery metadata, accepts[] with the two network options) — HTTP status stays 200; the plain-HTTPS path documented in the README uses HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead. (3) Gate order: payment gate precedes argument validation — call_tool(url_parse, {url:12345}) and call_tool(cusip_validate, {cusip:'!!!not-a-cusip!!!'}) both return the same PaymentRequired challenge instead of a validation error, so an agent cannot learn its arguments are wrong without paying; unknown tool name returns RPC -32602 'Unknown tool' for free (MCP layer validates tool existence before the gate). (4) Signed submit: x402 v2 payload {x402Version, resource, accepted, payload:{authorization, signature}} built from the challenge (EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, value=1000, validAfter/validBefore from maxTimeoutSeconds 300, nonce random) signed with a burner EOA over the challenge-supplied domain (USD Coin v2, chainId 8453, verifyingContract USDC) and submitted in params._meta['x402/payment'] -> server forwarded to the facilitator: verify returned invalid_exact_evm_insufficient_balance in 1.04s — the signature was VALID (not invalid_signature), the failure is the balance check, i.e. the payload shape and EIP-712 domain are correct end-to-end; the failed verify response carries the full fresh challenge (same accepts, new terms) so the client can retry after funding. No settle transaction, no charge; burner balance 0/0 before and after (evidence 21). (5) 'If the tool fails, you're not charged': pre-payment failures are free by construction (no payment token in the request); the post-payment refund/settle-on-failure path requires a funded wallet and is UNVERIFIED in this run — the observable equivalent is that no settle ever occurred without a valid payment (facilitator balance-gates before settle).

records.summary: First classification run of the frozen evidence lens, sandbox-stand platform (RUNBOOK 1.2), node v24.22.3, window 2026-11-22T18:50:41Z..18:50:44Z UTC, zero money moved. Leg A — self-run against the sealed attempt rows of record #0021 (argus-seal-0021): the frozen classification, derived only from the sealed rows (verdicts.jsonl pinned in the record), reproduces every sealed verdict and the cross-trial invariant with zero divergences — R1-1..3 and R4-1 sort delivery-retry (identity tie via same op id, exactly one execution record, no second signature; R4 additionally republishes the same stored block with attempts recorded), R2a-1..2, R2b-1..3 and R3-1..3 sort separate-purchase (attempts distinguishable in the records: fingerprint mismatch refused with stored op byte-identical / winner-only budget with distinguishable amounts / distinct keys refused wallet_busy). Leg B — dataset[0] raen-ledger-before: the six adjacent near-duplicate pairs (980, 2010, 3235, 3586, 3828, 4204 ms) recompute exactly as registered; all six classify absent because the settlement rows carry no idempotency key and no intent digest — the only record-side grouping (payer, service, route, amount_usd) cannot distinguish a delivery retry from a separate purchase; matches the registered expectation. Leg C — dataset[1] zambo-a5-lost-response: the posted record is one journal entry of the lost-response-harness (sequence 1, prev_hash null, declared side effect state_write) inside hash-covered canonical bytes (sha256 of decoded canonical bytes == output_hash, recomputed at run time); it carries no payer, no idempotency key, no intent digest, no purchase reference (inputs redacted) and no pair of submissions, so the C4 question classifies absent and the in-thread claim ('effect count was one before and one after, no second execution') is not recomputable from this record alone; matches the registered expectation. All input pins recomputed before use (verdicts.jsonl against the #0021 record pin; both dataset captures against the draft pins). The checker holds only the frozen records: no wallet_ops, no transport logs, no operator word; timing is never consulted. Divergences total: 0. The main seal 0028 stays in the operator signing queue (P5 allowlist); further datasets enter as new pinned runs per the frozen extension rule.
